meta.title: Consumer Price Index, September 2026
meta.note: Retrieved with curl -sL. The endpoint 301-redirects to /data-catalogue/?id=<id> and the response is a bare JSON array of row objects.
meta.trim: cpi_headline_inflation trimmed to 2015-01 onwards. cpi_state_inflation trimmed to division=overall and 2024-01 onwards. cpi_headline trimmed to 2010-01 onwards. cpi_strata trimmed to divisions 01, 04, 07 and overall. cpi_lowincome trimmed to divisions 07, 11 and overall. fuelprice trimmed to series_type=level. Nothing else was changed: every retained row is a row the API returned, with its values untouched.
